import ctypes as C,os,json,time,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('/native');os.environ.update(DISPLAY=':97',SDL_AUDIODRIVER='dummy',SDL_RENDER_DRIVER='software')
xv=subprocess.Popen(['Xvfb',':97','-screen','0','2000x1400x24','-nolisten','tcp'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL);app=None
try:
 time.sleep(.4)
 with (r/'smoke/player.log').open('w')as log:
  app=subprocess.Popen([str(r/'8sword-remake'),'--journey','--assets',str(r/'pack'),'--save-dir',str(r/'store'),'--capture-dir',str(r/'smoke'),'--continue','--scale','1'],stdout=log,stderr=log)
  until=time.monotonic()+20
  while time.monotonic()<until:
   assert app.poll()is None,(app.returncode,(r/'smoke/player.log').read_text())
   try:
    s=dict(l.split('\t',1)for l in(r/'smoke/status.tsv').read_text().splitlines())
    if s.get('phase')=='monthly':break
   except(FileNotFoundError,ValueError):pass
   time.sleep(.02)
  else:raise AssertionError('restore boot timeout')
  expected=json.loads((r/'expected.json').read_text());assert s['state_hash']==expected['state_hash']and s['guard0']=='26,10,10,0,0,0'and s['steps']=='324'and s['gold']=='116'
  # Close the native window through its normal window-manager event.
  x=C.CDLL('libX11.so.6');x.XOpenDisplay.argtypes=[C.c_char_p];x.XOpenDisplay.restype=C.c_void_p;d=x.XOpenDisplay(None);assert d
  x.XDefaultRootWindow.argtypes=[C.c_void_p];x.XDefaultRootWindow.restype=C.c_ulong;root=x.XDefaultRootWindow(d)
  x.XQueryTree.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_ulong,C.POINTER(C.c_ulong),C.POINTER(C.c_ulong),C.POINTER(C.POINTER(C.c_ulong)),C.POINTER(C.c_uint)];rr=C.c_ulong();parent=C.c_ulong();children=C.POINTER(C.c_ulong)();n=C.c_uint();assert x.XQueryTree(d,root,C.byref(rr),C.byref(parent),C.byref(children),C.byref(n));assert n.value==1;window=children[0]
  class Data(C.Union):_fields_=[('l',C.c_long*5)]
  class Client(C.Structure):_fields_=[('type',C.c_int),('serial',C.c_ulong),('send',C.c_int),('display',C.c_void_p),('window',C.c_ulong),('message',C.c_ulong),('format',C.c_int),('data',Data)]
  class Event(C.Union):_fields_=[('client',Client),('pad',C.c_long*24)]
  x.XInternAtom.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_char_p,C.c_int];x.XInternAtom.restype=C.c_ulong;x.XSendEvent.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_ulong,C.c_int,C.c_long,C.c_void_p];x.XFlush.argtypes=[C.c_void_p]
  x.XSetInputFocus.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_ulong,C.c_int,C.c_ulong];x.XKeysymToKeycode.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_ulong];x.XKeysymToKeycode.restype=C.c_uint
  xt=C.CDLL('libXtst.so.6');xt.XTestFakeKeyEvent.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_uint,C.c_int,C.c_ulong];x.XSetInputFocus(d,window,1,0);code=x.XKeysymToKeycode(d,0xffc9);xt.XTestFakeKeyEvent(d,code,1,0);x.XFlush(d);time.sleep(.05);xt.XTestFakeKeyEvent(d,code,0,0);x.XFlush(d)
  until=time.monotonic()+10
  while time.monotonic()<until:
   s=dict(l.split('\t',1)for l in(r/'smoke/status.tsv').read_text().splitlines())
   if int(s.get('captures','0'))>=1:break
   time.sleep(.02)
  else:raise AssertionError('explicit F12 capture timeout')
  meta=dict(l.split('\t',1)for l in(r/'smoke/capture-001.tsv').read_text().splitlines());assert meta['frame_hash']==expected['frame_hash']and meta['readback_equal']=='true';assert(r/'smoke/frame-001.ppm').read_bytes()==(r/'smoke/readback-001.ppm').read_bytes()
  e=Event();e.client.type=33;e.client.display=d;e.client.window=window;e.client.message=x.XInternAtom(d,b'WM_PROTOCOLS',0);e.client.format=32;e.client.data.l[0]=x.XInternAtom(d,b'WM_DELETE_WINDOW',0);x.XSendEvent(d,window,0,0,C.byref(e));x.XFlush(d);code=app.wait(timeout=10);assert code==0
  (r/'smoke/receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status='passed-detached-native-boot',exit=code,expected=expected,actual=s,captured=meta),indent=2)+'\n')
finally:
 if app and app.poll()is None:app.terminate();app.wait(timeout=5)
 xv.terminate();xv.wait(timeout=5)
